name: lqt-quality-rubric-mcp
description: Design learner-friendly quality rubrics with Proficient as the mastery anchor and criterion-specific YES/AND/BUT/YET levels.

interface.longDescription: Design clear quality rubrics aligned to a grade level, Learning Target, learner task and specific Proficient expectations. Use two to four distinct observable criteria. Write the Proficient YES mastery anchor before deriving Distinguished YES/AND, Developing YES/BUT and Beginning NO/YET. Include learner revision prompts and feedback stems; do not score unless requested. Accept the educator's grade level as unrestricted typed text; never present grade choices or a constrained dropdown.
capabilities: Review rubric structure and criterion alignment
Create usable prompts and feedback stems
defaultPrompt: Help me design a quality rubric.

positive.prompt: Use get_quality_rubric_framework with grade_level "Adult workforce training", learning_target "I can explain safe food-handling procedures", learner_task "Demonstrate safe food preparation", proficient_expectations "choose for me".
positive.expected_behavior: Accept exact user-entered adult setting without grade menu, return framework using mastery-anchored levels.

positive.prompt: Use get_quality_rubric_framework for Grade 8, target: I can support a claim with relevant evidence and reasoning, task: write an argumentative paragraph, expectations: clearly connect evidence to claim.
positive.expected_behavior: Capture reasoning and evidence quality, not merely paragraph length; use full four-level rubric.

positive.prompt: Use get_quality_rubric_framework with grade_level "Kindergarten", learning_target "I can explain what plants need to grow", learner_task "Observe and draw a plant".
positive.expected_behavior: Accept Kindergarten without restriction and adapt descriptions for young learners.

positive.prompt: Use review_quality_rubric for target I can support a claim with evidence, task argumentative response, with rubric_rows=[{"Criteria":"Evidence","Distinguished":"Strong evidence","Proficient":"Shows evidence","Developing":"Some evidence","Beginning":"No evidence"}].
positive.expected_behavior: Reports transparent phrase-pattern failures and professional-review questions, without pretending to certify alignment.

positive.prompt: Use review_quality_rubric for target I can explain energy transfer, task food web explanation, with rubric_rows=[{"Criteria":"Explanation","Distinguished":"YES I correctly explain energy flow AND justify complex interactions","Proficient":"YES I correctly explain energy flow","Developing":"YES I identify energy flow BUT one direction is inaccurate","Beginning":"NO I cannot identify the flow of energy YET."}].
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies supported YES/AND/BUT/YET structures and promotes criterion-specific review.

negative.prompt: Find cheap flights to New York.
Open my school student database and grade individual learners without my supplying rubric or work.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access private records, invent data, or grade learners.

negative.prompt: Create a standards-aligned rubric with no numerical scoring requested.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not automatically assign point scores, percentages or grades.

publication.release_notes: Retain unrestricted free-text grade-level entry and mastery-anchored YES/AND/BUT/YET quality rubrics; add demonstration video for review.
